description: Export the merged lexicon in a format for another tool: 'claude-md' (markdown for CLAUDE.md / system prompts), 'markdown', 'text', 'wispr', 'superwhisper', 'whisper-prompt', 'openai', 'macos', 'espanso', 'deepgram', 'assemblyai', 'speechmatics', 'azure', 'google', 'csv', or raw 'json'. Aliases: 'wispr-flow' means 'wispr', 'wisprflow' means 'wispr', 'wispr-flow-csv' means 'wispr'. The first content block is the export itself, exactly what the CLI export command writes. A second block, only when there is something to say, is a note for you, not part of the export: the format left entries out to stay within its target's limits (named in the note), the export is empty (no terms yet, or none matched `categories`), or the repo has an untrusted project .lexicon.yaml whose terms were left out (relay it to the user).

categories.description: Only include terms in these categories. Omitted: every category.

limit.description: Cap the number of terms exported (at most 10000), applied after `categories`: up to this many terms are kept, in this order: the most hits first; at equal hits (every term starts at 0) brand, person and product terms first; then canonical A to Z. The formats that write one row per alias (csv, wispr, superwhisper, macos, espanso) count only terms that have an alias, since a term without one writes no row. Omitted: every term.

name: export_lexicon
title: Export the lexicon
